proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B H hA hB hAB hH hperp
  have hM := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.inner_vsub_center_midpoint_vsub hA hB
  have hsub : midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ H ∈ (line[ℝ, A, B]).direction := AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction (wbtw_midpoint ℝ A B).mem_affineSpan hH
  rw [direction_affineSpan, mem_vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hsub
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hsub
  have hz : inner ℝ (midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ H) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right (midpoint ℝ A B) H s.center, inner_sub_left, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev s.center (midpoint ℝ A B), ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev s.center H, inner_neg_left, inner_neg_left, hM, hperp]
    simp
  rw [← hk, inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hz
  have hne : ‖B -ᵥ A‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (vsub_ne_zero.mpr hAB.symm)
  have hk0 : k = 0 := by
    simpa [hne] using hz
  rw [hk0, zero_smul] at hk
  exact (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp hk.symm).symm
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B H : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → A ≠ B → H ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] → inner ℝ (s.center -ᵥ H) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 → H = midpoint ℝ A B
